_comment: Sign snippets for the Midheaven (career direction) and North Node (path of growth). 1–2 sentences, second person. Only 'approved' points are shown in the app.

Aries.meaning: You may be drawn to work where you can lead, start new things and act with courage. Careers that reward initiative and independence can suit you.

Taurus.meaning: You may thrive in steady work that builds something real and lasting, at a pace you can trust. Fields linked to beauty, food, nature or craft can appeal to you.

Gemini.meaning: You may do well in work full of variety, ideas and communication. Writing, teaching, media or sales can be natural places for your quick mind.

Cancer.meaning: You may be drawn to caring work that makes people feel safe and supported. Roles in teaching, care, food, home or community can feel meaningful to you.

Leo.meaning: You may want work where you can shine, create and inspire others. Leadership, the arts, entertainment or any role with a stage can bring out your best.

Virgo.meaning: You may thrive in work where your care for detail and wish to help can shine. Fields like service, research, editing or organizing can suit your practical mind.

Libra.meaning: You may be drawn to work that brings people together and creates harmony or beauty. Design, law, diplomacy or client work can suit your fair, friendly style.

Scorpio.meaning: You may want work with depth, where you can dig into problems, transform things or handle what others avoid. Research, psychology, detective work or problem-solving roles can suit your focus.

Sagittarius.meaning: You may be drawn to work that lets you explore, teach or share big ideas. Travel, education, publishing or anything with room to grow can suit you.

Capricorn.meaning: You may want to build a solid career step by step and earn real respect along the way. Management, business, public service or any field with a clear ladder can suit you.

Aquarius.meaning: You may be drawn to work that is original, forward-looking or good for society. Technology, science, social causes or independent projects can suit your inventive side.

Pisces.meaning: You may be drawn to work that is creative, compassionate or spiritually meaningful. Art, music, caring roles or helping others can feel like a calling to you.

Aries.meaning: Your path of growth may involve learning to act on your own and trust your instincts. Leaning into courage, rather than always keeping the peace, can help you feel more alive.

Taurus.meaning: Your path of growth may involve slowing down and building calm, simple security. Finding peace in steady, everyday comforts, rather than constant intensity, can help you feel grounded.

Gemini.meaning: Your path of growth may involve staying curious, asking questions and listening to other views. Learning from everyday conversations, rather than only big beliefs, can open your mind.

Cancer.meaning: Your path of growth may involve opening up emotionally and making room for home and family. Letting yourself be cared for, rather than only working and achieving, can bring you peace.

Leo.meaning: Your path of growth may involve stepping forward, creating and letting yourself be seen. Sharing your own heart, rather than blending into the group, can help you shine.

Virgo.meaning: Your path of growth may involve building helpful routines and practical skills. Turning dreams into small daily steps, rather than drifting, can help you feel steady and useful.

Libra.meaning: Your path of growth may involve partnership, cooperation and seeing others' needs. Learning to share and compromise, rather than always going alone, can bring you balance.

Scorpio.meaning: Your path of growth may involve going deeper, sharing honestly and welcoming change. Letting go of the need for comfort and sameness can help you grow strong.

Sagittarius.meaning: Your path of growth may involve exploring big questions and trusting your own beliefs. Seeking meaning, rather than only gathering facts and opinions, can give your life direction.

Capricorn.meaning: Your path of growth may involve taking charge of your goals and building something in the world. Stepping into responsibility, rather than staying in your comfort zone, can help you grow.

Aquarius.meaning: Your path of growth may involve joining others for a shared cause and valuing what makes you different. Thinking of the wider community, rather than seeking the spotlight, can feel deeply fulfilling.

Pisces.meaning: Your path of growth may involve trusting your intuition, compassion and quiet faith. Letting go of perfection and control, rather than over-planning, can bring you peace.
